claim: ADR 0264 (F-154, restated there): the daily event-prep-check job (ScheduledTasksService.sendEventPrepReminders) returns on the unarmed EVENT_PREP_REMINDERS_ENABLED flag as its FIRST statement, before it calls runPerTenant or reads calendar_events, so while the flag is unset it enumerates no house (DEFAULT_RESTAURANT_ID included), reads no row and sends no mail. This row pins the guard's placement and shape after comments are stripped: the guard is the first statement, its block ends in an unconditional return and holds no other if or return; eventPrepArmed() is exactly the eventPrepRemindersEnabled(ConfigService ?? process.env) reader with nothing around it; eventPrepRemindersEnabled is exactly the trimmed, lower-cased true/1 allow-list (the RECURRING_ORDER_REMINDERS_ENABLED parse); triggerEventPrepReminders only awaits sendEventPrepReminders. The behavioural proof is apps/api-gateway/src/communications/event-prep-reminder.spec.ts.
